vendor_enquiries.message: Hi Simran, we loved your work at the 2025 Conclave. We have a prospective high-level round table event coming up on Nov 28 in Gurugram for 200 CEOs. Could you advise if you have availability and approximate rates for a 360-degree thematic LED immersive backdrop?

responses.message: Hello Priya! Delighted to hear from you. Yes, we have our P2.6 ultra-fine pitch modules available for Nov 28. We can easily construct a 270 or 360 degree panoramic curved display. We can also provide a dedicated 3D motion graphics loop customized with your summit branding. I will prepare a detailed quotation for you shortly!

service_catalog.name: Paid Promotion & Brand Activations
service_catalog.tagline: Strategic campaign placement across high-density campus and student networks
service_catalog.description: Request a paid promotional placement or campaign for a brand, campus event, product launch, or student initiative. The Vistaro delivery team reviews your brief, coordinates multi-channel placements, campus ambassador activations, and digital broadcasts.
indicative_process: Submit campaign brief, target audience, budget range, and creative collateral
Vistaro marketing team reviews scope, confirms available channels and dates
Receive customized promotional quote with concrete channel deliverables
Review and approve quote to schedule campaign execution with live proof links
scope_boundaries: Vistaro coordinates placement across verified university channels, partner screens, and student clubs
Does not guarantee artificial impressions or vanity virality metrics; focuses on verified reach and target relevance

service_catalog.name: Promotional Video Shoot & Editing
service_catalog.tagline: Cinematic campus teasers, aftermovies, high-production reels & multicam edits
service_catalog.description: Request end-to-end planning and production of high-impact promotional videos, festival aftermovies, founder interviews, or institutional spotlights. The Vistaro team brings experienced camera operators, gimbal pilots, cinema lenses, sound recordists, and rapid-turnaround post-production editors.
indicative_process: Submit creative video brief, shoot dates, preferred aesthetic reference, and required deliverables
Vistaro video team reviews logistics, equipment needs, and crew availability
Receive formal quote covering shoot duration, equipment tier, revisions, and release licenses
Accept quote to assign dedicated Director of Photography (DP) and lead editor with milestone tracker
scope_boundaries: Includes storyboard alignment, on-site filming, sound design, color grading, and agreed revision rounds
Drone permits and specialized campus permissions coordinated jointly with host institution

service_catalog.name: Event Planning & Ground Execution
service_catalog.tagline: Turnkey event planning, vendor coordination, run-of-show & on-the-day stage management
service_catalog.description: Request expert assistance in orchestrating complex campus festivals, tech conferences, product launches, or corporate convocations. The Vistaro team assists from initial vendor procurement and risk assessment to on-the-day technical coordination, VIP escorting, and stage run-of-show execution.
indicative_process: Submit event scope, expected footfall, venue parameters, required services, and budget estimate
Vistaro event lead reviews feasibility, required vendor categories, and timeline
Receive comprehensive service quote itemizing stage management, logistics, and crew allocation
Accept quote to assign dedicated Event Lead with shared milestone checklist and run-of-show
scope_boundaries: Includes turnkey on-site coordination, vendor cueing, stage schedules, and safety monitoring
Third-party equipment and catering costs are either consolidated or contracted via Vistaro marketplace
